item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.3.1
New - Read a saved item without leaving the app: select it in Knowledge and the note, page or file text opens beside the list. - Rename a conversation in Ask.
Changes - A quieter look throughout: plain section headings instead of small caps, one card style for Knowledge, History and Ask, and status lines written as sentences. - Link rows in Knowledge show the site and the page, not the whole URL.

inklet Portal for macOS 0.3.0
New - Ask inklet: a conversation with everything you have saved. Open it from the sidebar, the app menu, or ⌘⇧A. Ask a question and inklet searches and reads your notes and answers as it writes; ask it to make a card or put an earlier picture back on a display and it does that for you. Part of Pro.

inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.5
New - Knowledge search now looks through your whole library on the server: titles, note text, links, filenames, and what inklet read out of your images and files. It no longer matches only the rows already loaded.

item.title: 0.2.4-alpha.1
item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.4 Alpha 1
Highlights - Quote/0: connect a Dot. Quote/0 as a third display type under New Display, with a Dot. API key and the panel's serial number. inklet sends every picture through the Dot. cloud; nothing to flash, nothing to tap. The panel then works like any other display: push to it from the composer, let inklet choose it, advance its queue, bring back an earlier picture. - Quote/0 panels are drawn at their own 296x152 shape, show a "Dot. cloud" reachability row and the reason when Dot. refused a picture.
Requirements - The inklet backend must be at the release that serves POST /api/devices/quote0 and has DEVICE_CLOUD_CREDENTIAL_KEYS set; until then connecting a Quote/0 reports that it is not enabled yet. - In the Dot. app, the panel's loop task needs an "Image API" item, or Dot. refuses every picture.
Known limitations - Alpha quality; requires macOS 26. - Pre-release build: it lands on the beta update channel.

inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.3
Fixes - Sign in with Apple and Google buttons use the same corner radius as the sign-in form above them.

inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.2
Fixes - Sign in with Apple and Sign in with Google buttons follow each provider's brand guidelines: sizes, colours, logos, and Google Sans for the Google label.

inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.1
Fixes - The Dock icon now stays while any window is open. "Keep in Dock" only decides whether it remains once just the composer is left. - Sign-in: the Apple and Google buttons follow the portal's style and spacing, with the proper logos.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.3
item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.0 Beta 3
Changes since 0.2.0 Beta 2 - Display pages read their history and switch what is showing through the new Presentation API: Show Next reports an empty queue honestly, and any earlier card can be put back on the display. - Settings now do what they say: Launch at login, Show in Dock (with a menu bar item), system notifications for delivered, failed, and offline, and weather on Home. - Settings tabs are ordered General, Notifications, Account, About.
Known limitations - Requires macOS 26.
